horoscopes.horoscope: Today, you will crave total freedom in whatever you are doing, says Ganesha. And sheer entertainment is on the cards for teenyboppers, like mall-hopping or going for a film. The kids will demand a Jumbo Berry ice cone. All in all, it will be a family day for you. A mushy conversation with your darling is on the cards. Have a brainstorming session with your lover tonight to boost your romance. You may get some fantastic ideas and turn wild and naughty to please your sweetheart. Have fun. After all, it’s good for your emotional appeal, says Ganesha. Your heart will be full of joy. Rs a result, you shall glow and spread happiness wherever you go today. Naturally, the positive vibes will also get reflected on your health and well-being. In high spirits, you shall swiftly complete your tasks. Today you will be concerned about financial planning and long term security. Your desire to have more stable financial graph will increase, and you will pay more attention to expenditure. An ideal day to put forward best of your efforts, suggests Ganesha. You will feel confident and energetic today. Since you are determined to do so, you will finish all your tasks within the deadline. The pressures will ease off in the evening, foresees Ganesha.

In all probability, it is a favourable day to begin financial planning, says Ganesha. You will focus on your relations and leave no stone unturned to make them prosper. You may yearn for a quiet getaway and end up spending a small fortune to get what you want. Love life will blossom as you may adopt creative ways to win your partner’s heart. You may play some romantic tunes and hold your partner softly while cooking your favourite dish or caress your sweetheart while watching a favourite romantic movie. A fun-filled time is on the cards, feels Ganesha. Fitness will be on the top of your priority list for today. Overflowing with energy and enthusiasm, you shall easily meet the deadlines of all your tasks. With enough time to spare, you will devote the evening just for exercising. Today you may wish to buy new ornaments or jewelry. You will be willing to present yourself as a charming person in social functions, thus you may wish to buy branded clothes that look classy. Today is the best time to launch new projects and decide the plan of action for ongoing ones. Meetings on financial issues should go well. Today you will be able to decide independently on important matters, says Ganesha.

You will spend the day safeguarding sentiments of others and it is in your own interest. For most part of the day, probably the entire day, you will be away from your family, mostly on a trip for business or leisure purposes. Today, having a successful career will be only thing on your mind. You may refresh yourself in the company of your loved one by spending quality time with him or her. You may sweeten your relationship by giving gifts to your loved one. A romantic evening keeps both of you engaged, foresees Ganesha. You may have to toil on this challenging day. But, if you expect immediate results, you shall get disappointed. You have tried your best, however the planets are less favourable. Just continue the good work – tomorrow will be better. On the financial front, today you shall be a bit careful. You may, however, end up paying too much for some immediate requirement. Ganesha advises you to do proper market research before buying anything. Fruitless pursuits may eat away your time today, foresees Ganesha. Ensure that your hard work doesn’t just go to the ‘recycle bin’. Concentration on work may certainly give you a productive day, suggests Ganesha.

You are a master of deception, and your sugar-coated comments play a pivotal role in your methods. Today, you will be able to smell trouble from a distance, and will know when to take a U-turn. Your methods may not make you very popular with the so-called moral brigade working with you, but you may think that this is the easiest way to the top. Ganesha, however, is not too sure that these tactics will work on a long-term basis. You will remain stress-free today and enjoy peace of mind. This will bring a smile on your face. A delightful evening with your partner is on the cards. Discussing the future with spouse will be the best idea, suggests Ganesha. You need to delegate work to people whom you can count on. You should not take all the load yourself as it might drain your energy. Besides, your aura would be positive today so you could make new friends who too will be helpful. If you have you been thinking of going out for a movie, or planning a dinner with your beloved, or looking to woo someone of the opposite sex just by spending money, then today is an auspicious day. It’s the best day for group activities. You will be in the right frame of mind to perform well in the meetings. Your diligence and commitment to work shall reward you in future, foresees Ganesha. You will have a nice day to talk to your HR regarding salary hike, bonus or incentives.

There are chances of conflict on the home front today. However you will be able to solve these problems owing to your understanding nature. However, these conflicts would likely not have cropped up if you would have paid more attention to your family. You appreciate the wonderful things in life today, says Ganesha. Being busy and bossy in work may turn off your sweetheart. Relationship with your loved one must be handled tactfully. You will simply put aside your love life due to excess work. Sending funny jokes or romantic notes will keep him or her happy, says Ganesha. From morning, you shall be full of beans. Needless to say, you will readily take up tasks that are challenging. Success will easily come your way, and boost your morale. Refrain from debating trifle matters to maintain your good mood. You need to be extremely careful while lending money, as it will be very difficult for you to recover it. Today you can start some project of your own which later turn out to be monetarily beneficial. Your creativity will see its maximum boost. Ganesha feels that since your creativity will be emphasized today, you will be more imaginative. You will tend to be ambidextrous and score high on productivity, says Ganesha.

You will shine exceedingly well in all the activities that you undertake today. Your dream of starting business operations on foreign shores will fructify today, says Ganesha. You may pay more attention to your personal appearance, which will boost your morale considerably. Your mercurial spirit is so high today that you may not be able to finalize your most desired travel destination. You will be busy drawing up plans for a trip with your family or beloved. A historical place or a jungle trip seem to be on your cards now, feels Ganesha. You will be in good health and humour today. Your plans will work out well. You will be supported by luck. This is the best time to charge yourself by doing activities which you like the most. You will stay more practical and composed. On this day, luck will be in your favour with respect to money matters. Your approach towards expenses will help you. You will be research well buying or selling anything. Luck is on your side today. You will be the champion in the mind of your boss. With a practical attitude, you will excel at your work. Your boss will be more than happy with you as you will finish all tasks on time.

Ganesha says those of you who are married or in love will experience a good time today. As you spend more time with your life partner by going out for a drive or for dinner, you will come closer to them. Today is a day full of joy, vigor and happiness for you. You like to be in an experimental mood. Your fascination for beautiful clothes, perfume and accessories will drive your partner crazy. Your sensuality will mesmerise your lover into whipping up a romantic mood for a steamy interlude. Today will be all about health and well-being. Review your food habits and follow a balanced diet plan. Eat healthy food at regular intervals throughout the day to keep fit. Exercise daily, take adequate sleep, and avoid long working hours. It is unlikely that today you shall find any logic behind your current financial status and will be wondering how to progress. Ganesha feels that this is the time to sit back, relax and be happy with what you have. An excellent day for showing off your creative side. In fact, if you are designing a software, a few random changes might jazz up the entire thing! You will be able to deliver the best project under a strict deadline, feels Ganesha.

Being a workaholic may divert your attention from your family and you may have to bear the consequences. It’s time to sort differences with your spouse. But, all this while, you need to be calm and patient. Watch your words in case of any arguments, warns Ganesha. You are loyal and faithful to your loved one. You will listen to your sweetheart with your heart’s content. Love life should be harmonious as you will agree to anything said or decided by your beloved, says Ganesha. Work may be piling on your desk, but your body is sending signals to your mind. Listen to your inner voice – it is time to go home. Avoid working late hours – relax in the evening with loved ones to revitalise yourself. Today is an auspicious day to arrange a get-together and spend big money on a big party. This is also a favourable day to invest some money on informal business parties or conferences. Meetings at the office will go well, by the grace of Ganesha. However, you may have to agree to your colleagues’ point of view. Mingling with your colleagues can give you a sense of belonging. You need to maintain your dignity.

To do or not to do? That will be the question for most of today as you find yourself pulling out of one dilemma only to trip into the next one. Controversy will surround you and you may find yourself at the crossroads, where you are unsure of which direction to take. Turn to the wisdom of the experienced for proper guidance, advises Ganesha. Balance your professional and personal life so well that neither is ignored. You may not be able to spend adequate time with your sweetheart. You have to be courageous as you may get detached. Get ready to woo and please your loved one, suggests Ganesha. Generally you devote time for your job/business and family, but hardly spend time for yourself. Make sure you allot some time for yourself. Go to a hill-station or holiday resort to seek solitude and achieve peace of mind, advises Ganesha. Today you shall learn how to save money. You will think twice before buying anything and unless it is essential, you shall avoid it. This is a good time to borrow money to legitimate needs. Ganesha foresees a busy day for you today. Even if your colleagues are whiling away time, you may slog at work. A variety of work will come your way and you will feel indecisive. You may not be able to keep up the expected speed, feels Ganesha.

If you are planning to fly to foreign shores for further studies, start documentation and other preparations today, says Ganesha. Whether you are a student or not, on this favourable day, all you need to do is to make a priority list, follow it and finish off your work one by one. If you are associated with Stock Market, expect an advantageous day ahead. You will be able to fulfill your sweetheart’s demands. Getting close to him or her will be easy. Lovers will find the intensity of love at a dizzying peak, says Ganesha with a wink. You will finally be able to develop a great bond in the relationship. After completing all your daily tasks, spend some time to play your favourite game or sport, in order to rejuvenate your mind and body. In the evening, you should go to a multi-cuisine restaurant to treat yourself and your loved ones. Ganesha feels that today is a favourable day to plan your budget for the long-term. However, stars are not in favor of investing in real estate. Money may be spent on leisure activities. Ganesha advises you to handle official meetings judiciously. Decision making will prove your forte. You may develop new professional skills which inspire you to embark on an ambitious project. Sort out important problems as it may jeopardize its progress.

Meeting people from different walks of life, having a good conversation with them and widening the horizon of your knowledge – this will be the highlight of today for the Bull. At work, you will have a busy day with plenty of meetings, discussions, planning and execution, feels Ganesha. You will fully utilize your energies, but it will leave you exhausted. Fortunately, you will spend quality time with your family members or your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You will bring many changes to domestic lifestyles. Your partner may help you understand the meaning of true love and commitment. After working very hard during the last few days, the time has come to take a break and give rest to your tired muscles and bored mind. You will therefore feel like doing something different and interesting to refresh yourself. Today you may buy handicraft items to decorate your home. You can arrange a movie show at home with friends and relatives or can plan to invite them for lunch or dinner. Troubleshooting might present major hassles at work today. Directed projects might land up on your table and you may have to follow your superiors’ orders. You will be busy in fulfilling your promise . Quality will be your priority, feels Ganesha.

Today you will get attention from the opposite sex and this will play an important role in your success in the near future. Due to the favourable alignment of the planets you will recieve more than your expectations. Ganesha feels that even though you are a calculative and cautious person, you will tend to be aggressive, outgoing and willing to take risks today. This could also translate in you trying your luck in uncertain fields like gambling, stocks or betting. You may turn curious and discuss some whys and hows today rather than mere facts. Intellectual discussions with your loved one will quench your thirst for knowledge, assures Ganesha. You may close the discussion with some interesting banter and exciting remarks. Expect a change on this unusual day. You may feel physically drained and mentally exhausted as you will overtax yourself, especially your mind. Try to strike the right balance between work and leisure. Just take a break to regain fitness. Spending money behind projects or assignments would be worth it. Your creativity shall peak and you will be good with words so it’s the best time to do something that can be financially helpful. You may feel confused in the new projects in the morning. With clouds of confusion getting cleared today, you will emerge a winner. Despite hurdles, you may be able to meet deadlines at the end of the evening.
